title: Media Production v1 has no native 3D/model/GLB output kind
workflow: native Blender source -> GLB delivery -> production record
symptom: The existing Production output enum cannot accurately label a GLB/model artifact without misclassifying it as interactive or another medium.
expected_behavior: 3D/model artifacts should be representable without semantic distortion when 3D becomes a recurring Media production surface.
actual_behavior: Current output kinds are article, video, audio, image, captions, interactive, and publication-package.
proposed_fix: Do not patch for one work. If native 3D production repeats, extend the existing Production schema minimally using an established model/3D term and migrate with tests.
fix_attempt: None. The GLB is represented precisely in the existing Works artifact registry using model/master roles while Production v1 declares only the key image output.
verification: No duplicate taxonomy or second truth system was introduced.
